method: All 15 pages rendered with Poppler at 125 dpi and individually viewed after the final build.

pages.finding: Title, subtitle, author accents, edition date, abstract and review attribution readable; no clipping.
Status table, inherited drive, normals, matrix and tent formula fit; source-status distinction visible.
Port/storage definitions, boxed complete system and dimensional table readable; table lies between complete sentences.
Jacobian/transposes, factor one-half, complete loading work and integrated balances clear; zero-state discussion fits.
Global theorem complete; profile norms, energy norm, local contraction and dependence equation readable.
Proof continuation clearly presents H1, approximation, global restart and separate forcing estimate; no omitted or clipped lines.
All launch asymptotics and nonzero-drive example legible; prepared-credit statement and reversing map complete before page break.
Prepared-credit proof continues clearly; invariant theorem, exact ceiling and doubled-phase proof fit.
3.4074 percent initial-core denominator and qualifications prominent; phase covariance and exact native equations legible.
Full native square, ordered hybrid theorem, baseline, potential domain and rational positive increment readable.
Decoupling, cadence and zero-stratum qualifications clear; per-port work definitions and endpoint convention readable.
Window account, retained-ratio theorem and arbitrary-preparation witnesses clear; no collisions or clipped equations.
Geometry distinctions, exact-O qualification, evidence limits and conclusion readable; appendix statement complete before proof continuation.
Both distinct domain-exit proofs retained; fast-time bounds, hyperbolic solution and existential cadence quantifiers legible.
All six references and portable/immutable links legible, no unresolved citation or margin overflow.

result: PASS. No clipping, overlap, missing glyphs, unreadable tables or unresolved references found. Ordinary proof continuations are retained; final render bytes are in external closeout.
